text: They don't need to pay for a booking tool anymore. I just built my very own on Replet, and it even takes payments. All I did was describe what I wanted, and it built the entire thing, from calendar structure, availability rules, and even confirmation emails. Then I asked it to add a way to receive payment, and since Stripe was already built in, it was complete one-shot prompt from a single message. Plus, you can also add it live on your own domain like I did. So if you want to try it for yourselves, just comment, book down below, and I'll send you guys the link directly.
